protocol: Offline hybrid path: local Vietnamese vocabulary plus multi-cue botanical hints; Gemini disabled. Ten manually written Vietnamese descriptions, two per class among the five featured classes. Precision@5 is measured on CLIP's global top five before category filtering; category hint accuracy/coverage are reported separately. This small hand-authored query set is not random, independently annotated or a general-purpose relevance benchmark.
